jobs.description:
As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

Responsibilities

• Evaluate backend and endpoint infrastructure to define upgrades, changes, and expansion proposals.
• Conduct feasibility studies and evaluate hardware and software solutions to meet organizational needs.
• Develop technical designs in alignment with specific architectural requirements and implement system improvements.
• Provide high-level support and maintenance for the IT infrastructure following ITIL methodologies.
• Deliver technical advice and information to internal and external stakeholders regarding the technology stack.
• Maintain technical documentation and actively share expertise within the engineering team.

Requirements

• You possess 8+ years of experience in system engineering within large-scale environments of at least 100,000 endpoints.
• You have expert knowledge of Intune, including MDM, MAM, BYOD, Enterprise Mobility + Security, and Conditional Access Policies.
• You bring advanced expertise in System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), focusing on distribution groups, task sequences, and software management.
• You have in-depth experience with Active Directory, LDAP, GPO, and domain management.
• You possess deep expertise in infrastructure stacks for Windows, MacOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.
• You have 5+ years of experience with PowerShell and VBScript for infrastructure automation.
• You bring broad knowledge of Azure, including license assignment and dynamic groups, alongside Office 365 and Windows Defender.
• You possess a solid understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLAN.
• You’re able to interact effectively with diverse technical and business stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with a very good level of English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications in MCSA, MCSE, or MCSD.
• Experience with ServiceNow or PM² methodology.
• Knowledge of PatchMyPC or 3rd party MDM solutions like Knox or KAI.

jobs.occupation: Cybersecurity Incident Response Officer – Sentinel & SIEM
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Conduct digital forensic investigations and analyze security artifacts across IT, IoT, and OT environments.
• Perform proactive threat hunting using SIEM and custom tools to identify anomalous behaviors and indicators of compromise.
• Develop and optimize detection rules and use cases based on the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
• Automate security event responses and develop playbooks to streamline operations within the SOC and CSIRT.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external security providers to communicate incident progress and mitigate risks.

Requirements

• You have 4+ years of experience in a security-focused role with a core specialization in incident response and analysis.
• You possess deep expertise in security monitoring using Sentinel SIEM, EDR, and Microsoft Defender.
• You bring hands-on experience with digital forensics, malware analysis, and artifact analysis for Windows and Linux systems.
• You're experienced in SOC Engineering, including use case development and the automation of alert handling.
• You possess working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and ServiceNow SIR modules.
• You have experience in the organization and animation of security tabletop exercises.
• You have obtained relevant certifications such as GCIH, GCFE, GCFA, GNFA, GCIA, or GREM.
• You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify suspicious activities on complex networks.
• You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or equivalent professional experience.
• You are fluent in English (C1) with working knowledge of Dutch or French.

Compliance • Conformity • Governance • Operational Readiness • License to Operate
  
 
  
PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
  
Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
  
 
  
About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
  
 
  
Your Mission: as a PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.

• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects.  
• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables.  
• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities.  
• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.   
Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
    
• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes.  
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers.  
• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths.  
• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.   
Operational Readiness & License to Operate
    
• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution.  
• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation.  
• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks.  
• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and ...

Education & Experience
    
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline.  
• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects.  
• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management.  
• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset.  
• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.   
Knowledge & Affinity
  
You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
    
• European product legislation and conformity assessment;  
• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles;  
• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF);  
• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness;  
• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements;

Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
